# Parkside Residences @ Setia Federal Hill, Bangsar (www.setiafederalhill-parkside.my)

> Marketing site for Parkside Residences, the first residential tower of the Setia Federal Hill masterplan on Jalan Bangsar, Kuala Lumpur, developed by Setia MF SFH Development Sdn Bhd (a joint venture of SP Setia and Mitsui Fudosan). Managed by Yee Woei Shyan (REN 46305), IQI Realty Sdn Bhd. Not the developer's official website.

## Key facts
- Project: Parkside Residences @ Setia Federal Hill (also written Parkside Residence Bangsar)
- Developer: Setia MF SFH Development Sdn Bhd (SP Setia and Mitsui Fudosan)
- Address: Jalan Bangsar, Setia Federal Hill, 59200 Kuala Lumpur
- Type: high-rise serviced residences, leasehold
- Tower: 62 storeys, 693 units, 14 units per floor, 8 high-speed lifts
- Layouts: 9 types, 485 to 1,325 sq ft, 1 to 3 bedrooms (Type A 485, B 689, C1 646, C2 732, D1 872, D2 926, D3 1,012, E1 1,260, E2 1,325 sq ft)
- Price: from about RM 650,000; the developer's price list changes, ask the agent for the current one
- Maintenance fee: RM 0.50 psf
- Facilities: five levels of amenities including an infinity pool, gym, landscaped gardens, co-working space and a 62nd-floor sky lounge, beside a 5-acre central park
- Location: Bangsar LRT about 400 m, KL Sentral one LRT stop, Mid Valley and Abdullah Hukum nearby, ERL to KLIA from KL Sentral
- Estimated completion: 2030
